studies.title: Cassava
studies.caption: Cassava stores starch in long roots beneath a branching shrub. American growers developed processing methods that made the crop useful as a staple.
studies.prompt: Low-angle botanical study of Manihot esculenta shrub with palmately divided narrow-lobed leaves on long petioles; several lifted long brown rough storage roots lying beside base, one cut section showing white interior. Amazonian garden, no potato eyes or roots hanging from branches, no people.
